subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should compaction use the same aborted-turn drop policy as the prompt-send sanitizer for orphaned tool-call turns, or preserve the interrupted turn with a synthetic result?
rationale: Both directions can produce provider-valid transcripts, but they encode different session-state semantics: dropping avoids fabricated tool results while losing the interrupted attempt from the summary.

options.title: Accept drop policy
options.body: Merge this PR's narrow repair and treat aborted assistant tool-call turns as invalid context for compaction summaries.

options.title: Require synthetic recovery
options.body: Ask for a revised PR that preserves interrupted turns by inserting an explicit synthetic result with provider-acceptance and model-interpretation coverage.

options.title: Pause for shared transcript policy
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers define one shared policy across prompt-send, replay, durable repair, and compaction transcript recovery.

recommendation.title: Accept drop policy
recommendation.body: Merge this PR's narrow repair and treat aborted assistant tool-call turns as invalid context for compaction summaries.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently merged adjacent Anthropic orphaned tool-use classification work and are already tagged in the PR discussion for this failure class.
